Usage: hpgl [--help] [--output OUTPUT_DIR] [--drawing-sheet SHEET_PATH] [--define-var KEY=VALUE] [--exclude-drawing-sheet] [--default-font] [--pages PAGE_LIST] [--pen-size PEN_SIZE] [--origin ORIGIN] INPUT_FILE

Export HPGL

Positional arguments:
  INPUT_FILE                   Input file

Optional arguments:
  -h, --help                   Shows help message and exits
  -o, --output                 Output directory
  --drawing-sheet              Path to drawing sheet, this overrides any existing project defined sheet when used
  -D, --define-var             Overrides or adds project variables, can be used multiple times to declare multiple variables. Use in the format of '--define-var key=value' or '-D key=value'
  -e, --exclude-drawing-sheet  No drawing sheet
  --default-font               Default font name
  --pages                      List of page numbers separated by comma to print, blank or unspecified is equivalent to all pages
  -p, --pen-size               Pen size [mm]
  -r, --origin                 Origin and scale: 0 bottom left, 1 centered, 2 page fit, 3 content fit
